catalog.revision_note: power-armour rebuild: resin figure, helm, backpack and 32 mm base
catalog.base: 32 mm round deck-plate base, 4 mm, 5 × 2 mm magnet pocket
catalog.description: The Vigil heavy gunner rebuilt in power armour: domed pauldrons that rise round a low-set Ironclad helm, a barrel cuirass with the raised split-chevron emblem, abdominal lames, massive bracers and greaves, knee hydraulics and a reactor pack with twin exhaust stacks. Fires the VW2-09 Partisan LMG from the hip, left fist on the fore-grip. Helm and backpack are separate keyed parts; 0.1 stays in the catalogue.
buildNotes: Pose and skeleton from the 0.1 figure (same sockets, pegs and base); armour from tools/powerarmor.py, sized with unified-CAD-MCP miniature_power_armor_plan.
Helm from the 0.3 helm library (tools/helms04.py) and pack from tools/powerarmor.py, both through tools/morph.py print_safe_selective.
Quick printability screen only (unified-CAD-MCP miniature_printability_check, upright); no support plans or full certification yet.
catalog.limitations: Procedural sculpt; quick printability screen, not a test print or full check. No STEP reference.
